scenarios.name: terminal-new
scenarios.why: a new zECS tranid typed at a terminal: the counter is defined, the TD record written, WRITE OPERATOR sent with TEXTLENGTH 74, ROUTECODES X'0111' and NUMROUTES 2, then the START and the SEND

scenarios.name: terminal-bad-input
scenarios.why: input shorter than transid,tranid: the ER_0010 message path, no counter defined

scenarios.name: terminal-wrong-transid
scenarios.why: the first four bytes of the input are not the transaction that ran (EIBTRNID ZNCD): CLC sets CC 1 or 2, the BC B'0111' is taken to ER_0010 (the true arm of the TransID check), no counter defined

scenarios.name: terminal-duplicate-counter
scenarios.why: the DEFINE DCOUNTER fails because the counter exists: the ER_0020 message path

scenarios.name: commarea-non-terminal-start
scenarios.why: an 8-byte COMMAREA (the DSECT's length, EIBCALEN 8): started, not typed at a terminal -- the transid comes from CA_TRAN, no RECEIVE

scenarios.name: commarea-too-short
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 4, not 0 and not the DSECT's 8: ABEND with ABCODE(EIBTRNID), NOHANDLE

scenarios.name: commarea-one-byte
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 1, the smallest non-zero length: the same ABEND

scenarios.name: commarea-too-long
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 9, longer than the DSECT: the same ABEND (the test is equality, not a minimum)
